## Find and inspect (Client; starts on Gallery; R133, R134, R135, R136, R137, R138, R139)

4. Gallery: Clear search and select Outdoor category → Seven photos appear in the grid
Success: Client successfully finds and inspects a photo using search and filters
If it goes wrong: Search or filter does not update correctly or photo details do not match → Client clears search or resets filters, or refreshes the page to restore state

## Select, annotate, and persist (Client; starts on Gallery; R140, R141, R142, R143, R144, R145, R146, R147)
1. Gallery: Begin in an empty Draft state → My Selection shows empty state with return-to-Gallery action
2. Photo detail: Open Golden Hour and add it to selection → Golden Hour appears in My Selection, count updates
3. Photo detail: Add note: 'Please soften the background.' → Note saved locally without separate save button
4. Gallery: Add four other photos to selection → Five photos selected, count updates everywhere
5. Gallery: Attempt to add a sixth photo → Limit is enforced with accessible feedback
6. My Selection: Open My Selection and confirm the same five records and note → Five photos displayed in original order with notes
7. Gallery: Reload page → Selection and note persist across reload
Success: Client selects, annotates, and persists five photos correctly
If it goes wrong: Selection exceeds five, notes are lost on reload, or state is not preserved → Client removes a photo to make room, or reloads the page to restore state

## Remove and replace (Client; starts on My Selection; R148, R150, R151, R152, R153)
1. My Selection: Begin with five selected photos → Five photos displayed in original order
2. My Selection: Remove one photo from My Selection → Count updates everywhere, photo removed from selection
3. Gallery: Add a different photo → New photo added to selection, count updates
4. My Selection: Confirm correct five in sample-data order → Photos displayed in original order with updated selection
5. Photo detail: Reopen removed photo and confirm any previously saved note remains → Note restored when photo is reopened
Success: Client removes and replaces a photo correctly while preserving notes
If it goes wrong: Photo note is lost when replaced or selection order is incorrect → Client reopens the photo to restore note, or reloads page to reset state

## Submit and lock (Client; starts on My Selection; R154, R155, R156, R157, R158, R159, R160)
1. My Selection: With fewer than five selected, confirm submission cannot proceed → Submission button disabled with explanation
2. Gallery: Select exactly five photos → Five photos selected, submission becomes enabled
3. My Selection: Open submission dialog and cancel → Nothing changes, selection remains unchanged
4. My Selection: Open submission dialog again and confirm → Submission confirmation dialog appears with summary of five photos and notes
5. My Selection: Confirm Submitted status, timestamp, and correct five photos → Submitted state is locked, selection and notes are frozen
6. Gallery: Verify shortlist and note editing are locked across screens → No changes can be made to selection or notes
7. Gallery: Reload page → Submitted state remains locked
Success: Client submits selection correctly, and the state is locked across all screens
If it goes wrong: Submission proceeds with fewer than five, or state is not locked after submission → Client selects exactly five photos and confirms submission again, or reloads page to reset state

## Start over (Client; starts on My Selection; R161, R162, R163, R164, R165)
1. My Selection: Begin in Submitted state → Submitted status, timestamp, and five photos displayed
2. My Selection: Open Start over and cancel → All submitted data remains unchanged
3. My Selection: Open Start over again and confirm → Confirmation dialog appears explaining that it clears selection, notes, status, and timestamp
4. My Selection: Verify empty Draft selection and cleared notes → Selection is reset to empty state with no notes
5. Gallery: Reload page → Reset persists across reload
Success: Client successfully starts over after submission, clearing all data correctly
If it goes wrong: Data is not cleared or reset fails to persist across reload → Client cancels and retries the start-over action, or reloads page to restore state

Every test exercises the app: never compare a value with itself or assert text you wrote into the test. Write every test out in full: never park one with it.todo, it.skip or xit (a parked test checks nothing, so the step isn't done while one is there). Don't weaken a test to make it pass: fix the app. But a test that contradicts the sample data or the requirement (it expects an item the search excludes, or a category the data doesn't have) is wrong: correct it to what the requirement means.
